verdict.rationale: Inline commenting on specific text or images within an item's description is a fair collaboration question for an issue tracker like Jira, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents inline or anchored comments on description text or images. The only description-related evidence is a complaint that copying description text triggers editing, which is not a commenting capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
